name: Multipurpose Rechargeable Desk & Camping Fan with LED Light, Flashlight & Power Bank
description:
Stay cool and powered anywhere with the Multipurpose Rechargeable Desk & Camping Fan. This all-in-one device combines a fan, LED light, flashlight, and power bank, making it perfect for home, office, or outdoor adventures. Lightweight and portable, it ensures comfort, convenience, and reliability wherever you go.
Key Features
 Dual-use: perfect for desk and outdoor activities
 Rechargeable and portable with USB charging
 Adjustable fan speeds and light brightness
 Built-in power bank for device charging
 LED light + flashlight for emergencies
 Compact, lightweight, and easy to carry
Ingredients / Materials
ABS plastic body, rechargeable lithium battery, LED light, motor fan blades
How to Use
 Charge fully via USB cable before first use
 Adjust fan speed using control button
 Use LED light or flashlight with one-touch switch
 Connect devices to USB port for power bank function
 Carry in a bag or place on a desk for versatile use
Package Includes
 1 × Rechargeable Fan with LED Light & Power Bank
 1 × USB Charging Cable
 1 × User Manual
